**It looks like you’re adding a “reviews” feature to your Lovable‑Supabase store.** That means we’ll be dealing with user‑generated content and some personal data, so the safest approach is an **Amber** build. Below is a one‑screen plan with the safety parts we’ll build in, followed by a couple of quick questions so we can tailor it to your exact needs. --- ## One‑Screen Plan (Amber) | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **What we’re building** | A star‑rating plus written review section for each product | | **Who uses it** | Customers who log in to the store (each has a private account) | | **Risk level** | **Amber** – logins, personal data, content moderation | | **Day‑one features** | 1️⃣ Add a “write review” button on a product page
2️⃣ Show average rating & existing reviews
3️⃣ Allow users to edit/delete *their own* reviews | | **Information it stores** | Review text, star count, user ID, product ID, timestamps (all private to the reviewer, visible only to the reviewer and the product page) | | **Logins** | ✅ Magic‑link e‑mail login (Supabase Auth) – users must be logged in to write, edit or delete a review | | **Money** | ❌ No payments involved | | **Built with** | Lovable + Supabase (database + Auth + Storage for any optional photos) | | **Steps** | 1️⃣ Create `reviews` table with RLS (owner‑only edit/delete)
2️⃣ Add UI components in Lovable: write button, review form, list of reviews, edit/delete links
3️⃣ Write serverless function (Supabase Edge) to handle CRUD with RLS checks
4️⃣ Add basic moderation‑style validation (no empty reviews, max length, no spam)
5️⃣ Run safety checks (secret keys, RLS, test user flow) | | **Safety** | • Keys stay on server only (Supabase secret key in `.env`)
• Data locked to owner (RLS + Supabase Auth)
• Edits/deletes only for own reviews
• Soft‑count star rating (UI only)
• Save point before each step | | **Not in first version** | • Photos attached to a review (optional later)
• Review moderation queue
• Admin dashboard for reviews | --- ## Quick Starter Questions 1. **Do you already have a login system set up, or should we add a simple Supabase Auth magic‑link flow?** (If not, we’ll set up the login first; if yes, we’ll just verify it works for reviews.) 2. **Do you want users to be able to attach photos to their reviews, or just text + stars?** (Adding photos requires a separate bucket rule.) 3. **What kind of moderation (spam filtering, profanity) do you need?** (We’ll start with basic length checks; we can add extra filters later.) Answer those when you can, and we’ll start building step 1—creating the `reviews` table with the right RLS rules—right away!
